well.defEn: n. a deep hole or shaft for water; adv. in a good or satisfactory way; adj. in good health

right.defEn: n. the side opposite the left; a thing that is morally correct; adv. exactly; n. a moral or legal claim

open.defEn: v. move so people can go in; adj. not closed or blocked; v. start operating (a shop, business)

close.defEn: v. move so people cannot go in; adj. near in relationship or time; v. bring to an end

like.defEn: v. enjoy something; prep. similar to; in the manner of

leave.defEn: v. go away from; n. period of time absent from work (vacation)

mean.defEn: v. intend to convey or indicate; n. the average of a set of numbers

set.defEn: v. put in a particular position; v. (of the sun) go down below the horizon; n. a group of related things
